title: p0 export fd offset rewind fix

commit.merge_subject: merge: p0 export fd offset rewind fix

description:
Owner report 2026-11-13 ~13:30: every MP4 export failed with
'not a supported clip / re-import the clip / bad header / invalid
container version' (three attempts, re-import too) while clips
opened fine in the preview. The failing headers were verified good
('MOTION ' + version 3), so the files were never the problem.

Chain: with GPU Experimental selected, Mp4Exporter.export calls
exportOnce(GPU, fd) whose ExportPipeline first opens
rawedit::Source::open(fd) -> dup(fd) + fdopen -> the decoder reads
the header and seeks the index, advancing the shared file offset.
When the writer's Surface mode fails (SurfaceInputUnavailable) the
honest CPU restart calls exportOnce(CPU, SAME fd). Attempt 2's
Source::open dup()s that fd, but dup() shares the
open-file-description, so the offset is wherever attempt 1 left it
(mid-file). motioncam::Decoder(FILE*) init() reads the header from
the CURRENT offs
changed: fix: rewind fd offset on source open
